solutions.explanation: 20 is \(25\%\) of 80. The calculation here gives 25.
solutions.title: Use the percentage relationship

solutions.explanation:
Multiplication and division have equal priority, so evaluate from left to right. First \(20\div80=0.25\). Multiplying by \(100\) moves the decimal point two places to the right, so
\[
20\div80\times100=0.25\times100=25.
\]
solutions.title: Compute the decimal quotient, then multiply by 100
